name: major histocompatibility complex, class I, B

function.text: HLA-B encodes HLA class I histocompatibility antigen, B alpha chain. Annotated molecular activities include TAP binding and beta-2-microglobulin binding. It participates in defense response and immune response.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Esophageal Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
